article.title: GreenCart lifts full-year revenue outlook
article.text: GreenCart Grocers (GRCR) raised its full-year outlook on Thursday, saying it now expects revenue of about $17.2 billion for fiscal 2027, the year ending 30 January 2027, up from the $16.8 billion it guided in March. New stores in the south-west opened ahead of plan. Shares rose 3%.
